summary: Frontend-only verification of Lois-Tech background-removal + content-motion refactor (iteration 77). Confirmed: (a) animated page background fully removed across /templates, template full previews (creative_studio, healthcare, saas, legal), the Test Lab public site /p/pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f and /motion — data-testid='ambient-backdrop' count is 0 and there are 0 '.amb-blob' nodes everywhere; (b) content boxes are tagged '.cm-box' and reliably transition to '.cm-in' as they scroll into view with staggered delays; (c) hero motion layer still present over hero only, 30fps ceiling and pause off-screen/hidden work; (d) prefers-reduced-motion path skips tagging and no content stays hidden (0/16 hidden); (e) 390x780 mobile has no horizontal overflow and reveals work; (f) no permanently invisible '.cm-box' in viewport was observed once IntersectionObserver + 1.4s safety net had a chance to run.
critical_code_review_comments: ContentMotion safety net fires only at 1400ms after the last of two tag() runs (60ms and 700ms). If the user scrolls a lot within the first ~2s, some newly-in-viewport boxes can appear un-revealed for a short window before the IntersectionObserver fires. In practice this cleared within ~1.5-2.5s in every test I did, but a more robust approach would be to re-run the safety-net check on scroll (throttled) or lower the observer threshold from 0.12 to 0.05 on the initial pass.
Only 240 boxes are tagged (slice(0,240)). Fine for current templates (max 26 boxes) but worth documenting so no one wonders later.
